name: Drycha
canonNotes: A malevolent Branchwraith who despises all the non-forest races, Elves included, and wants the forest cleansed of intruders.
Leads the dark spirits of the wood in vengeance.
voiceNotes: Hissing, hateful and bitter; everything that is not the forest is prey.
No trust for Elves, humans or any civilised race.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
